title: runs.parquet row schema
description: Tidy one-row-per-(solver,problem,thread,build,rep) schema for benchmarks/study/results/runs.parquet. Core identity/contract/timing columns (required, frozen by this WU) plus an open set of denormalised quality-metric columns owned by common/metrics.{R,py} (a separate WU) via additionalProperties. Field semantics: contract.md.

solver.description: Solver id; must match a key in registry.json.

problem.description: Problem spec id; must match a spec/*.json id.

thread.description: Thread cap this cell ran under (OMP_/OPENBLAS_/MKL_NUM_THREADS + per-package equivalents).

build.description: leafblower build variant; 'na' for all competitor rows (build axis is leafblower-only).

iterations.description: Typed null (never 0 or the string "NA") when the wrapped package exposes no iteration count.

converged.description: Algorithmic convergence: status=='converged' after the bound-violation upgrade (harmonized status enum). NOT a margin_linf<=tol fit gate — margin_linf is a fit metric, no target to reach (contract.md §2.4).

wall_time_s.description: float64 seconds; SINGLE end-to-end axis (raw-rows-in → weights-out, groupby/cell/contingency build inside the timer for every arm); always present (contract.md §2.6). No solve-only axis — benchmark is strictly separate from leafblower (user constraint 2026-07-08).

peak_rss_bytes.description: int64 bytes; raw VmHWM of the timed subprocess (contract.md §2.7).

additionalProperties.description: Open extension point for denormalised quality-metric columns owned by common/metrics.{R,py} (DESIGN.md §6), e.g. marg_kl_mean, marg_kl_max, ess, deff, deff_g, linf, l1, bound_viol_mean, bound_viol_max, divergent. Not frozen by this WU.

dtypes._comment: Physical parquet dtypes, since JSON Schema's type system doesn't distinguish float32/64 or int32/64 (DESIGN.md §8 literal column list).
